reason: The cited evidence shows L1₂ precipitation and ~310 MPa strengthening in a cold-rolled Al0.7CoCrFeNi alloy, but the hypothesis applies this to an as-cast AlCoCrFeNi2.1 EHEA without establishing that the same precipitation kinetics, coherence, and property balance hold in the undeformed, compositionally different alloy.
premises: Annealing at 580°C for 24 h precipitates coherent L1₂ nanoparticles in the fcc phase of a related AlCoCrFeNi alloy
These L1₂ precipitates provide ~310 MPa precipitation strengthening with only ~2% ductility loss in that alloy
The same precipitation response and mechanical benefit will occur in the as-cast AlCoCrFeNi2.1 EHEA without prior deformation
